scoring_justification: DFT frequency calculation is compute-driven and cannot be recomputed by the lightweight verifier; comparing reported wavenumbers to the paper's Table 1 values with tolerance is the appropriate T0 check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference wavenumbers for the six vibrational modes, used as the hidden gold for T0 comparison.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper's Table 1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual DFT-calculated wavenumbers reported in the paper; they are the absolute reproduction target for this task. No synthetic values are used.

outputs.description: Harmonic vibrational frequencies (cm⁻¹) for selected modes of the low‑temperature organic cation computed at B3LYP/6-311G* with a correction factor of 0.97305.

steps.description: All six corrected wavenumbers must be within max(30 cm⁻¹, 5% of expected) to receive full credit; each failure reduces score proportionally.
